board.name: Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure

notes.text: The CME cycle is fixed: two years starting July 1 of each even-numbered year (the current cycle runs July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2028), while the license renews every year. Set CME Cycle Start to the cycle's first day.

window.reason: Rule 1.9 fixes two-year periods from July 1, 2022 (July 1 of each even-numbered year); the period holding the renewal date is counted.

topics.label: Prescribing of medications with an emphasis on controlled substances, Category 1, part of the 50 Category 1 hours

condition.question: Are you authorized to prescribe controlled substances?
condition.description: Applies to clinicians with controlled substance prescriptive authority.

agreement.text: PAs practice under a protocol agreed with the supervising physician and report the supervisor to the Board through MELS before practice. The supervising physician reviews 10% or 20 charts a month, whichever is less, and they meet face to face once a quarter. A new graduate, or a PA on an initial Mississippi license, has the supervising physician on site for 120 days or 960 hours.

unverified: Whether current NCCPA certification, or the one-time DEA 8-hour training, satisfies the 5 controlled substance prescribing hours
Whether the board's exemption for initial licensure during the cycle applies to PAs (the cited exemption is in the physician rule)

none.reason: The nursing CE rule was repealed in February 2020.

cycleYears.reason: RN and APRN licenses renew together every two years, expiring December 31 of even-numbered years.

notes.text: An RN out of practice for more than five years completes at least 20 contact hours in the 2 years before renewal.

ce.reason: Renewing national certification satisfies the general CE requirement; the 5 controlled substance hours are separate.

notes.text: Graduates within 2 years are exempt from the controlled substance hours for the first renewal only.

topics.label: Continuing education directly related to controlled substances, each state certification period, for every APRN

agreement.text: Every APRN practices in a collaborative relationship with a Mississippi physician under a formal collaborative agreement approved for each practice site before work begins and updated at each renewal. New APRNs complete 2,000 monitored practice hours with under a year of prior RN experience, or 1,000 with a year or more.
